author: mystikxkemix
tagline: Shared lists, watchlist, places and events
description: Website and backend of the Family iPhone app. Grocery and to-do lists, a movie and TV watchlist (with optional Radarr, Sonarr and Prowlarr), places to try and events, shared in a household, with push notifications. Admin page for users and settings. Needs a MongoDB.
title: Family API
